show.description: A simple taxi driver, Vikram, is pushed into a nightmare when a leaked video threatens his daughter Ananya’s dignity. As blackmail, crime, and dangerous strangers close in, Vikram’s suppressed dark side begins to take control. Torn between being a loving father and a ruthless killer, he must fight his inner demon to protect his daughter. How far will a father go when his child’s honor is at stake?
